zones.name: Briarwood
zones.description: A quiet town at the edge of the Whispering Wood.

zones.name: Whispering Wood
zones.description: A dark forest where the trees seem to murmur.

locations.name: Town Plaza
locations.description: The central square of Briarwood. A stone fountain stands at the center.

actions.label: Inspect the fountain
actions.description: Look closely at the old stone fountain.

hooks.text: The fountain is dry and moss-covered.

locations.name: Forest Entrance
locations.description: The trees grow thick here. It's getting darker.

plotlines.name: The Missing Merchant
plotlines.description: A merchant has gone missing in the Whispering Wood.

scenes.fiction: An old woman at the fountain approaches you. 'You look like someone who can handle themselves. My nephew went into those woods three days ago and never returned.'
The Whispering Wood lives up to its name. The trees creak and sway, though there's no wind.

challenges.description: Find your way deeper without getting lost

consequences.description: You trip over a root and twist your ankle.
You miss a subtle trail marker.
